title: A Picture of New-York in 1846: Hudson River Steam-boats
lineage: Inspected the cited passages; the retained file is a paraphrased research note.

passages.locator: pp. 104–105, extracts dated September and October 1807
passages.note: The guide reproduces a September 1807 advertisement for the North River steamboat listing a seven-dollar Paule’s Hook–Albany fare, and an October 2 report of a departure with ninety passengers; these are reported offer and passenger counts.
